full_prompt_en: The image is a square color landscape photograph centered on a solitary tree with a broad red autumn crown. The tree stands slightly left of center on a low ridge, its dark trunk rising from a small patch of reddish fallen leaves. The canopy is nearly round but irregular at the edges, where separate twigs and clusters of leaves remain visible. Deep scarlet and burnt orange dominate the foliage; the upper-right leaves catch a little more light and seem warmer than the shaded lower part. A narrow unpaved road begins at the bottom center and climbs toward the horizon, bending gently past the tree. Its pale, damp-looking track makes a clear route through dark, rough ground. A small simple building stands farther back on the right side of the road. It is subdued by fog, with only its pitched roof, front wall, and dark openings clearly suggested. Beyond the ridge, the landscape disappears into thick blue-gray mist. The sky takes up most of the upper half and shifts gradually from dark cool blue on the left to a paler gray-blue around the distant building. No sharp horizon or detailed mountains compete with the tree. The foreground is almost black in places, with scattered rust-colored leaves breaking the dark surface near the road. Light is soft and diffuse, apparently filtered through the fog; there are no hard shadows. The vivid tree color remains concentrated within an otherwise cool, low-saturation scene. The camera is placed low enough for the road to lead upward through the frame, while the isolated tree and small building balance each other across the crest. The photograph feels quiet and slightly dreamlike because strong color, simple silhouettes, atmospheric disappearance, and ample empty sky are held together without busy detail.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形彩色风景照片，以一棵树冠宽阔的红色秋树为中心。树略偏画面左侧，立在低矮山脊上，深色树干从一小片红色落叶中升起。树冠近圆但边缘不规则，仍能看见独立枝梢和叶簇。深绯红与焦橙色主导树叶，右上方叶片接受更多光，比下层阴影部分更暖。一条窄土路从画面下方中央起始，爬向地平线，缓缓绕过树。浅色、似乎潮湿的路面在粗糙深地面上形成清楚的路径。道路右侧更远处立着一座简陋小建筑。它被雾削弱，只能辨认尖屋顶、正面墙体和深色开口。山脊之外，地貌消失在浓厚蓝灰色雾中。天空占据上半部大部分空间，从左侧的深冷蓝逐渐过渡到小屋附近更浅的灰蓝。没有清晰地平线或详细山体与树争夺注意力。前景局部近黑，路边散落的锈红色叶片打破深色地表。光柔和而弥散，仿佛经过雾层过滤，没有硬影。艳丽树色集中在其余部分冷调且低饱和的景色里。相机位置使道路从下方引向画幅上方，孤树与小屋在山脊两侧相互平衡。强烈色彩、简明剪影、空气中的隐没和宽阔空天共同维持画面，照片因此安静而略似梦境。
style_prompt_en: Atmospheric color photography concentrates one warm, saturated area within a broad field of cool, subdued tones. Blue-gray haze dissolves distant contours and removes hard horizon lines, while nearer ground retains dark granular texture. Diffuse light softens transitions and creates no crisp cast shadows. A simple path or directional shape can pull the eye from a shadowed foreground toward a quiet point in the mist. Large open areas give a single vivid silhouette room to stand apart. Warm reds and oranges remain rich but localized, so they gain force from the surrounding cold blue and charcoal. The overall rendering is contemplative and softly cinematic, with depth expressed through fog, color separation, and gradual loss of detail.
style_prompt_zh: 这种有空气感的彩色摄影把一处暖而饱和的区域集中在广阔的冷淡色调之中。蓝灰雾消融远处轮廓，抹去硬朗地平线，近处地面仍留深色颗粒肌理。弥散光柔化过渡，不产生清晰投影。简洁路径或方向性形状将视线从暗前景引向雾中的安静一点。大片开放空间让一处鲜艳剪影得以独立。红与橙浓郁却局部集中，因此从周围冷蓝和炭灰中获得力量。整体沉思而柔和地富于电影感，纵深来自雾、色彩分离和细节逐渐消失。
theme_en: A solitary red autumn tree beside a narrow road in blue-gray fog
theme_zh: 蓝灰色雾中，一棵红色秋树立在窄路旁
name: Janek Sedlar
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
